start.studioText: AYLOUL brings architecture and graphic design into one continuous design practice. We develop ideas through drawing, form, space, material and visual communication, allowing each discipline to inform and strengthen the other.
start.leistungenIntro: From architectural form to visual communication.
start.arbeitsweiseIntro: Every form begins with an idea.
start.ingenieureText: For technical planning and construction supervision we collaborate with experienced engineers, so that the design reaches the site as it was drawn.
start.kontaktText: For enquiries and appointments, contact us via WhatsApp, phone or email.

ueber.unterzeile: One design language across architecture, space and image.
ueber.intro: AYLOUL is a multidisciplinary design studio working across architecture, interiors and graphic design. We approach each project as a connected design process, from the initial idea and its visual language to the spaces, forms and details that bring it to life.
verbundenText: At AYLOUL, architecture and graphic design are not treated as separate outputs. They are different scales of the same design thinking, connected through geometry, proportion, materiality, composition and visual expression.
This connection allows us to move between disciplines while maintaining a clear and coherent design language, from the smallest graphic detail to the larger architectural experience.
ueber.ketteSatz: A drawing can establish a visual system. A visual system can shape form. Form can become space. And space can define an experience.
ueber.gruendungText: AYLOUL was founded in Homs in September {jahr}.
ueber.ingenieureText: For technical planning and construction we work together with experienced engineers.

arbeitsweise.unterzeile: Every form begins with an idea.
arbeitsweise.introTitel: Design is a process of translation
arbeitsweise.intro: At AYLOUL, every project begins by understanding the idea behind the brief, then translating it into a clear spatial and visual language. We work through geometry, proportion, materiality, light, context and composition to develop spaces and forms that are coherent from concept to detail.

schritte.name: Idea
schritte.text: Defining the core idea and the intention behind the project.

schritte.name: Geometry
schritte.text: Establishing geometry, proportion and relationships that give the design structure.

schritte.name: Form
schritte.text: Translating the concept into form, massing, composition and spatial relationships.

schritte.name: Space
schritte.text: Shaping how the space is lived: its sequence, light, movement and the relationship between inside and outside.

schritte.name: Material
schritte.text: Using material, colour, texture and detail to establish character and atmosphere.

schritte.name: Experience
schritte.text: Bringing the elements together to create a coherent and considered experience.

exterior-architecture.name: Exterior Architecture
exterior-architecture.kurz: Architectural design and façade development shaped by proportion, material, context and a clear visual identity.
text: Exterior design at AYLOUL considers the building as part of a larger spatial environment. We develop architectural form, façade composition, landscape, movement and outdoor spaces as connected elements, responding to context while maintaining a clear and coherent design language.

aspekte.name: Form
aspekte.text: Massing, proportion and architectural character.

aspekte.name: Façade
aspekte.text: Composition, openings, rhythm and material expression.

aspekte.name: Landscape
aspekte.text: Planting, hardscape, circulation and outdoor experience.

aspekte.name: Context
aspekte.text: Site, orientation, surroundings and relationship to place.

interior-design.name: Interior Design
interior-design.kurz: Residential and commercial interiors shaped by material, light, colour and atmosphere, with a focus on spatial composition and refined detailing.
text: At AYLOUL, interior design begins with the relationship between people and space. We shape interiors through proportion, light, material, colour and movement, creating environments that feel coherent, purposeful and connected to their architectural context.
From the overall composition to the smallest detail, every element is considered as part of one spatial experience.

aspekte.name: Composition
aspekte.text: The layout, sequence and relationship of spaces.

aspekte.name: Light
aspekte.text: Daylight and integrated lighting.

aspekte.name: Materiality
aspekte.text: Materials, colours and textures.

aspekte.name: Atmosphere
aspekte.text: The character felt by the people who live in the space.

shop-drawings.name: Shop Drawings
shop-drawings.kurz: Precise architectural documentation translating design intent into coordinated, buildable details.
text: Technical documentation developed to translate architectural ideas into precise, coordinated and construction-ready drawings.

aspekte.name: Design intent
aspekte.text: Understanding the architectural concept, spatial requirements and design language.

aspekte.name: Development
aspekte.text: Translating the design into coordinated dimensions, materials, assemblies and details.

aspekte.name: Documentation
aspekte.text: Developing precise drawings that communicate the design clearly and consistently.

aspekte.name: Detail
aspekte.text: Resolving architectural elements through accurate construction information and technical detailing.

architectural-graphic-design.name: Architectural Graphic Design
architectural-graphic-design.kurz: Visual systems developed to clarify, present and communicate architectural ideas through graphic composition and visual storytelling.
text: Visual identities and graphic systems that communicate ideas with clarity, character and consistency. Where ideas take visual form.

aspekte.name: Identity
aspekte.text: Logo, colour and typography as one system.

aspekte.name: Information
aspekte.text: Presenting architectural information clearly.

aspekte.name: Composition
aspekte.text: Arranging image, text and space.

aspekte.name: Communication
aspekte.text: Consistent print and digital applications.

3d-visualization.name: 3D Visualization
3d-visualization.kurz: Realistic images of exterior and interior designs that show a project before it is built.
text: We produce realistic 3D images of façades and interiors, by day and by night. They help to assess proportions, materials and lighting before construction starts, and to present a project clearly to clients and partners.
The project images on this website are examples of this work.

aspekte.name: Exterior views
aspekte.text: Façades, massing and the surrounding site.

aspekte.name: Interior views
aspekte.text: Spaces, materials and furniture.

aspekte.name: Day and night
aspekte.text: Daylight and night-time lighting.

construction-supervision.name: Construction & Project Supervision
construction-supervision.kurz: Accompanying a project from design to construction, together with experienced engineers.
text: We accompany projects from planning to construction. Together with experienced engineers, we coordinate the execution of the design and follow the work on site, so that what is built stays true to what was designed.

aspekte.name: Coordination
aspekte.text: Linking the design to the construction stages.

aspekte.text: Following the work on site.

aspekte.name: Engineering expertise
aspekte.text: Collaboration with experienced engineers.
